The only factor that changes management is the bosentan interaction. The prescribed sildenafil 20 mg three times daily is the standard monotherapy starting dose, but with bosentan it is likely subtherapeutic. A specific dose increase to 40 mg three times daily (or titration) is required, with monitoring of clinical response and blood pressure. This is not merely a routine monitoring issue; it demands a dose change.

A second-generation antihistamine (e.g., loratadine or fexofenadine) or intranasal corticosteroid would be preferred.
